decisions.decision: One hybrid vector index (MODEL ALL_MINILM_L12_V2, VECTOR_IDXTYPE HNSW, SYNC ON COMMIT) on a new search_text CLOB replaces the step 4 embedding column and HNSW index
decisions.why: request asks for one index for lexical and semantic; the index vectorizes itself, so keeping VECTOR_EMBEDDING would embed twice
decisions.rejected: keeping both vector stores; a user datastore joining the path

decisions.decision: Migration 4 backfills search_text from symbols joined to files

probe: default index missed a committed row until sync; sync on commit found it immediately and keeps visibility transactional
decisions.rejected: ctx_ddl.sync_index after commit (window between commit and sync)

decisions.decision: Text side = each word wrapped in braces, joined with AND
decisions.why: probe: _ is a wildcard and url_for matched nothing unescaped; braces match literally; AND gives every-word semantics
decisions.rejected: raw question; ctx_query escape round trip

decisions.decision: Fetch CCCTX_SEARCH_CANDIDATES (100) rows, filter repos by rowid join, dedupe, definition boost via direct name lookup, cap 10
decisions.why: probe: filter_by unsupported; name lookup makes definitions-first deterministic
decisions.rejected: relying on fusion order for definitions

decisions.decision: Vector floor on vector_score/100; MCP keeps similarity and adds score, keyword_rank, semantic_rank
decisions.why: vector_score is the index's own 0-100 similarity (72.7 vs 0.62 raw cosine); additive output keeps clients working
probe: score_weight changes fused order; constitution IV configurable weights

decisions.decision: CCCTX_CODE_LEXER (BASIC_LEXER, PRINTJOINS '_') on the hybrid index
decisions.why: default lexer split url_for into url + stopword for, so keyword search matched every url line in uv.lock

decisions.decision: similarity = vector_score / 50 - 1, floor applied to semantic-only hits in hybrid and vector
decisions.why: measured: vector_score = (1+cos)/2*100; without a hybrid floor sourdough returned 10 weak matches
decisions.rejected: vector_score/100 (plan); floor in vector mode only

decisions.decision: Hybrid keyword side is ACCUM with $stem for plain words; text mode stays strict AND
decisions.why: AND with stopwords killed the keyword side for natural questions; stemming finds route for routed

decisions.decision: Keep only a file's best fallback window
decisions.why: near-duplicate uv.lock windows filled the results
decisions.rejected: excluding lockfiles at ingest (would need re-ingest and a new skip rule)
